CPU: export LC_ALL=C; nproc; lscpu | grep -m1 'Model name'
DISK: export LC_ALL=C; df -P / | tail -1; echo ---; lsblk -d -o NAME,SIZE,ROTA 2>/dev/null
NIC: export LC_ALL=C; ip -br link; for i in /sys/class/net/*; do printf '%s %s\n' "$(basename $i)" "$(cat $i/speed 2>/dev/null)"; done
ROCE: export LC_ALL=C; for p in /sys/class/infiniband/*/ports/*; do printf '%s|%s|%s\n' "$p" "$(cat $p/state 2>/dev/null)" "$(cat $p/rate 2>/dev/null)"; done
